_note: What each tag that a rule reads does, shown in hover tooltips. Any entity can carry tags in its data ("tags": [...] on enemies, hero classes, traits, townsfolk roles, buildings, item bases or relics; see Content.TAG_KINDS). Descriptive tags no rule reads yet are fine and show by name alone. When a rule starts reading a tag, add its line here: tests/test_tags.gd fails until you do. Prize tags (a building's "prize", like the hunting lodge's beast prize) are explained from data/buildings.json, so they need no line.
sentient: turns on whoever hits it, watch posts and the keep included
fighter: stands and fights, so it counts toward the town's power level; Horde Drum makes fighters stronger the more there are
siege: ignores people and heads for gates and the hearth; Ram-thorn Stakes hurt it each time it strikes; beating an attack made of them offers their spoils
plant: grows back; a Forester's hut nearby makes it regrow faster
human: Turncoat's Torc may turn it to your side when it falls; beating an attack made of them offers their spoils
beast: Wolf-mother's Skull keeps it off townsfolk unless they strike first; beating an attack made of them offers their spoils
undead: Grave Salt doubles the damage it takes; beating an attack made of them offers their spoils
pact: a strong relic with a real cost, offered every fourth round
spoils: taken from a beaten warband: offered beside the relics after an attack made of its kind
proud: sleeping rough sours their mood twice as fast; wearing steel cheers them
fire: sets the hearth's and watch posts' shots alight, so they light up the night
